extracted.name: Sausage Barley Soup
extracted.description: This is a nice sausage barley soup recipe with a lot of texture and flavor. It is a nice change for something different and easy for the slow cooker.
instruction_lines: Cook sausage, onion, and garlic in a skillet over medium heat until the sausage is evenly brown. Season with Italian seasoning. Remove from heat and drain.
Add sausage mixture, chicken broth, carrot, spinach, and barley into a slow cooker.
Cover and cook on High for 4 hours, or Low for 6 to 8 hours.
